title: Potential NVIDIA Deal Puts Fresh Focus On HP’s AI PC Future
title_zh: NVIDIA 潜在交易让惠普 AI PC 的未来重新受到关注
summary: NVIDIA is reported to be in advanced talks to acquire a major PC manufacturer, with HP and Dell widely viewed as the main candidates.
summary_zh: 据报道，NVIDIA 正在就收购一家主要 PC 制造商进行深入谈判，惠普和戴尔被广泛视为主要候选者。

title: Is Microsoft Corporation (MSFT) a Top AI Play on Azure Growth and Memory Supply Deal
title_zh: 微软公司 (MSFT) 是 Azure 增长和内存供应交易中的顶级人工智能公司吗
summary: Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) is one of the top S&P 500 stocks by index weight. On April 15, KeyBanc reiterated an Overweight rating on Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) and a $600 price target.
summary_zh: 微软公司（纳斯达克股票代码：MSFT）是标准普尔 500 指数权重排名前列的股票之一。 4 月 15 日，KeyBanc 重申对微软公司（纳斯达克股票代码：MSFT）的增持评级和 600 美元的目标价。

title: Firestone Country Club ownership could change as part of $3B deal
title_zh: 作为 30 亿美元交易的一部分，Firestone 乡村俱乐部的所有权可能会发生变化
summary: Private equity firm KSL Capital Partners seeks to buy Invited Clubs — which has Firestone Country Club and Silver Lake County Club in its holdings.
summary_zh: 私募股权公司 KSL Capital Partners 寻求收购 Invited Clubs，该俱乐部旗下拥有凡士通乡村俱乐部 (Firestone Country Club) 和银湖乡村俱乐部 (Silver Lake County Club)。

title: Palantir stock jumps on USDA deal, Boeing rises over Q1 results
title_zh: Palantir 股价因美国农业部交易而上涨，波音因第一季度业绩而上涨
summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma tracks today's top moving stocks and biggest market stories in this Market Minute, including Boeing's (BA) stock gains after reporting first quarter results and Palantir Technologies (PLTR) shares rising on its new deal with the US ...
summary_zh: 雅虎财经高级记者布鲁克·迪帕尔玛在本《市场分钟》中追踪当今走势最强劲的股票和最大的市场故事，包括公布第一季度业绩后波音 (BA) 股价上涨，以及 Palantir Technologies (PLTR) 股价因与美国达成新协议而上涨......

title: Modern Wealth Expands Into Colorado With $1 Billion Acquisition
title_zh: Modern Wealth 斥资 10 亿美元收购科罗拉多州
summary: Modern Wealth, a registered investment advisory firm with an aggressive acquisition strategy, announced Wednesday that it acquired Brown and Company, a wealth manager with $1 billion in assets based in Denver.
summary_zh: Modern Wealth 是一家采取积极收购策略的注册投资咨询公司，周三宣布收购了总部位于丹佛、拥有 10 亿美元资产的财富管理公司 Brown and Company。
